From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

Italian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Semi-learned borrowing from Latin resultāre, from resiliō.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ri.zulˈta.re/
    • Audio:(file)
  • IPA(key): (traditional) /ri.sulˈta.re/[1]
  • Rhymes: -are
  • Hyphenation: ri‧sul‧tà‧re

Verb

[edit]

risultàre (first-person singular present risùlto, first-person singular past historic risultài, past participle risultàto, auxiliary èssere)

  1. to turn out to be, prove to be or emerge as
  2. to appear or seem
